milestones.title: The verifier contract is specified, approved, and proven red
milestones.goal: A human-approved mission harness exists, the worker/verifier contract is explicit, and targeted red tests fail for the expected missing verifier behavior.

verification.expect: Targeted verifier contract/prompt suites fail for the expected missing verification behavior before implementation.

verification.command: Review ARCHITECTURE.md and SPEC.md against the requested independent-verifier design and write findings.
verification.expect: The review confirms the mission boundaries and verifier contract are correct or reports blocking findings with file references.

verification.command: Spawn an independent verifier agent to review the mission harness, red-test plan, and spec adherence; save its PASS/FAIL findings.
verification.expect: The spawned verifier confirms the mission harness is coherent or returns actionable issues before implementation continues.

verification.command: Launch the real CLI in a temp workspace and inspect the current visible surface for spawned-agent behavior; confirm there is not yet a user-visible verifier flow and record that the red state matches the intended pre-implementation baseline.
verification.expect: The visible surface confirms the verifier flow is not yet implemented, matching the red-test baseline rather than hiding an accidental partial feature.

milestones.notes: Do not begin implementation until architecture approval is explicit and the red harness is real, not imagined.

milestones.title: spawn_agent can run a worker followed by an independent verifier
milestones.goal: When verification is requested, the parent can spawn a worker, wait for its result, spawn an independent verifier, and receive a simple PASS/FAIL report with issues.

verification.expect: Targeted contract/runtime tests pass for verification defaults, sequential orchestration, and PASS/FAIL report shape.

verification.command: Inspect spawned child session details and assert the worker and verifier have distinct session ids and the parent retains the worker result plus verifier report.
verification.expect: Worker/verifier isolation and parent-visible composite result are both proven.

verification.command: Spawn an independent verifier agent to check the implementation against SPEC.md, runtime tests, and the milestone goal; save its PASS/FAIL findings.
verification.expect: The verifier confirms correctness and spec adherence or reports blocking issues before the gate closes.

verification.command: In a temp workspace, launch the real CLI and exercise a spawned worker with verification enabled; assert the visible output shows separate worker/verifier progress or results and that the parent receives a verifier PASS/FAIL summary.
verification.expect: The visible surface makes the worker/verifier sequence legible rather than hiding verification behind invisible state.

milestones.notes: The runtime milestone is not green until both the automated checks and the independent verifier agree the slice is correct.

milestones.title: Prompt, policy, and spawned-agent reporting surfaces are aligned with the verifier flow
milestones.goal: The tool descriptions, short system prompt, spawned-agent reminders/reporting, and `~/.mu/agent/AGENTS.md` all describe and support the verifier flow without drift.

verification.expect: Prompt/policy/reporting tests pass for tool descriptions, short system descriptions, and spawned-agent reporting surfaces.

verification.command: Review the final prompt and policy surfaces against SPEC.md and write findings.
verification.expect: The review confirms prompt/policy/runtime alignment or reports actionable blocking findings with file references.

verification.command: Spawn an independent verifier agent to check prompt, policy, and operability alignment against SPEC.md and milestone evidence; save its PASS/FAIL findings.
verification.expect: The verifier confirms the final slice is correct and legible to parent agents, or returns issues that must be fixed before closeout.

verification.command: Launch the real CLI in a controlled workspace and inspect the human-visible tool/report surfaces after implementation; verify that spawned-agent verification behavior is described consistently in the user-facing prompt/help/report flow.
verification.expect: The visible surface agrees with the prompt and policy text, with no drift between runtime behavior and what the user/parent agent is told.

milestones.notes: This milestone aligns human-facing contract text with runtime behavior and closes the mission only after final validation is green.
